title: talos.ticket/1
description: What `talos ticket status <N>` prints: who holds a ticket, since when, its branch's last commit and its newest PR. It exits 0 whatever it finds, an issue that doesn't exist included; 2 is an error and 3 a usage error, which print nothing on stdout. Thea's hub reads `schema`, `repo`, `issue`, `branch`, `claimed` and `agent`, which keep their meaning under this number.

branch.description: the ticket's branch, <prefix>-<issue>, whether or not it exists

state.description: the issue's state; null when there is no such issue

labels.description: the issue's labels; empty when there is no such issue

claimed.description: whether the ticket's branch exists: the branch is the lock, so this alone says someone holds the ticket

agent.description: the agent the latest claim comment a trusted author wrote names; null when the branch doesn't exist, or no such comment does yet

since.description: when that claim comment says the claim was made, as it says it (Talos writes an ISO 8601 time in UTC); null whenever `agent` is

date.description: its committer date; null when GitHub names none

lastCommit.description: the commit the branch points at; null when the branch doesn't exist

stage.description: queued is in the merge queue

checks.description: GitHub's combined state of the checks on the PR's last commit

pr.description: the newest PR from the branch, open or not; null when there is none
